description: Hex-head cap bolt per ISO 4014: a hexagonal head (width across flats s, height k jointly locked to the nominal thread diameter) with a fillet under the head where it meets the cylindrical shank; the shank is a nominal ISO 888 length and carries a modelled external metric thread (ISO 261 coarse pitch) rendered as a real single-start helical V-groove over the tip, leaving a smooth grip under the head, with a head top-chamfer on the hard tier. Covers M6-M24.
source: ISO 4014 (hexagon head bolts) head dimension table s/k; ISO 888 nominal length series; ISO 261 coarse thread diameters + coarse pitch series
